---
title: "2024-10-15_SouthernResidents"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggspatial)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
orcas <- read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-10-15/orcas.csv')


```

```{r}
glimpse(orcas)

unique(orcas$date)

orcas_year <- orcas |> 
  mutate(year = year(date),
         month = month(date)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(year)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(begin_longitude), !is.na(begin_latitude))

orca_season <- orcas_year |> 
  mutate(season = case_when(
    month %in% 3:5   ~ "Spring",
    month %in% 6:8   ~ "Summer",
    month %in% 9:11  ~ "Fall",
    month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

factor(orca_season$season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter"))

```

```{r, Landmarks for the map}
landmarks <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "Vancouver",
    "Vancouver Island"
  ),
  lon = c(
    -122.70,
    -124.35
  ),
  lat = c(
    49.18,
    48.88
  )
)

landmarks_sf <- st_as_sf(
  landmarks,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)
```


```{r}
land <- ne_countries(
  scale = "large", returnclass = "sf"
) |> 
  st_transform(4326)

vancouver_land <- land |> 
  filter(
    admin %in% c("Canada", "United States of America")
  )


loc <- st_as_sf(
  orca_season,
  coords = c("begin_longitude", "begin_latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)

#Check if points are on land
on_land <- lengths(st_intersects(loc, vancouver_land)) > 0

#Remove points on land
loc_clean <- loc[!on_land, ]

```

```{r}
season_counts <- loc_clean |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(season) |>
  mutate(label = paste("Sightings:", n))

season_counts
```


```{r}
season_palette <- c(
  "Spring" = "#78B77A",
  "Summer" = "#E9B44C",
  "Fall" = "#D47745",
  "Winter" = "#5B83B4"
)
```


```{r}



loc_clean |> 
 #filter(year == 2024) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = vancouver_land) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = landmarks_sf,
    aes(label = name),
    fontface = "italic",
    colour = "grey25",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data = season_counts,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = -1,
    size = 3,
    colour = "grey25",) +
  
  geom_sf(aes(color = season), size = 1) +
  
  coord_sf(
    xlim = st_bbox(loc_clean)[c("xmin", "xmax")],
    ylim = c(49.3, 47.8)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Distribution of Southern Resident Killer Whales",
    subtitle = "Sightings around Vancouver Island, British Columbia from 2017 to 2024",
    caption = "Data: https://www.whaleresearch.com/encounters | Analysis: Simon Gendrisch",
    x = "",
    y = ""
    )+
  
  facet_wrap(~season)+
  
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Roboto", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "Roboto",
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10,
        colour = "grey40"
      ),
    strip.text  = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold"
      ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      family = "Roboto Light",
      size = 12
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      family = "Roboto Light"
    ),
    
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = season_palette)


```

ggsave("orca_distribution.jpg", plot = p, width = 297, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
